module_unreachable.title: Viega module {device} is not reachable
module_unreachable.description:
Home Assistant has received no response from the Viega Fonterra module **{device}** since {since}. Room values stay at their last known state until it responds again.

Check that the module is powered and connected to the network. The integration keeps reconnecting on its own, and this message disappears automatically once the module responds again.

base_unit_error_3.title: Viega module {device}: A room thermostat is no longer connected
base_unit_error_3.description:
The base unit of **{device}** reports error code {code}: At least one room thermostat is no longer connected to the base unit.

This message disappears automatically once the base unit no longer reports the error.
